records.ptx_feature: PTX ISA 9.1 minimum; CUDA 13.3 emits PTX 9.3

stages.representation: pure inline PTX with a single packed source operand
stages.detail: CUDA 13.3 libNVVM compiled the 1,807-byte NVVM IR fixture (SHA-256 83e41481b170703c62b0ff63f647cb04b4e3e9b4c12b7c16a9fe6ad2d0a64bc9; four kernels pinned through llvm.used, each one inline-PTX call with a single packed i32 source operand) with -arch=compute_120f to 2,485-byte PTX (SHA-256 858cee379e200e21b36c1fbe0b76af425f37cc4057300ac9da7d0be9d873b62d; .version 9.3, .target sm_120f) retaining all four instructions verbatim, and with -gen-lto to 3,228-byte LTOIR (SHA-256 8c47b71a4f042ccb6713381bd52c58c4d05e74d910b16f19cade2d0c688e4ce4).

CUDA 13.3 ptxas assembled the libNVVM PTX at sm_120f into a 13,768-byte cubin (SHA-256 f0a9b794cfd3da2368b5576e6bd99f747d82c0f2d7d60dfb5fa1c2241f925076) whose SASS holds one F2FP.SATFINITE[.RELU].{E4M3,E5M2}.BF16 per kernel, F2FP.SATFINITE.E4M3.BF16 for this form. The same fixture compiled for compute_120 is rejected at sm_120 with "Feature 'cvt.e4m3x2.bf16x2' not supported on .target 'sm_120'".
stages.tool_version: Cuda compilation tools, release 13.3, V13.3.73; build cuda_13.3.r13.3/compiler.38244171_0

stages.representation: libNVVM LTOIR retaining all four bf16x2 to packed-FP8 conversions
stages.detail: CUDA 13.3 nvJitLink linked the sm_120f LTOIR with -lto into a 13,896-byte cubin (SHA-256 d11dba66e56c2124a3ce2b8f9ef6c5c54a8930a9ac20ec32735b64e3355d0b71) that keeps all four kernels and their F2FP instructions. Linking the same LTOIR for sm_120 fails with the ptxas feature error.
